summary: Large financial data provider evaluating Redwood for low-latency RAG / enterprise search. Primary concerns: UK/EU data residency, sub-100ms p95 search + rerank, index scale (100M-2B docs), and per-query cost. Leaning toward Dedicated/Private with Optimize add-on for batching/caching recommendations.
notes:
- Quick notes from calls / SE sessions:
  - "Needs": UK-first routing + automatic EU failover; can't send raw PII outside UK boundary without encryption/KMS custody.
  - Scale: currently ~1.2B smaller documents (logs/filings); POC sample 150M. Expected growth ~2x in 12 months.
  - Latency targets: search (ANN) ~20-50ms median, end-to-end reranked response (search + cross-encoder rerank) p95 < 200ms ideally, hard limit 300ms.
  - Cost sensitivity: wants rough cost per query at 95th percentile; target ~0.5-1.5 pence GBP / query for production workload.
  - Architecture preference: hybrid - local dedicated nodes in UK region (private VPC) for hot indexes + cold tier in eu-west for archived vectors. Failover -> eu-west if UK outage, but must preserve residency for non-fallback data.
  - Reranker: prefers distilled cross-encoder for precision; worried about latency. SE suggested cascade: ANN candidate set (fast) -> lightweight transformer reranker (quantized / int8) -> final cross-encoder on dedicated capacity for critical queries.
  - Observability asks: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency SLO charts, anomaly alerts for recall drop.
  - Security & compliance: KMS/HSM key custody, SSO (Okta), full audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, retention controls per regional laws.
  - Quotes from CTO: "We need search results you can put in front of traders; even 200ms jitter is noticeable."
  - Open items: legal wants sample data residency clause; finance wants committed throughput pricing and rollback terms for initial 12-month contract.
  - Links: pricing deck v3 (see drive), security questionnaire answers in drive doc, Fireflies notes above.
  - Jira: INF-3421 opened for POC infra provisioning (requested UK-dedicated pool + KMS integration), INF-3499 for security QA followups.
  - Next practical: run 72-hour POC perf test (UK pool) with 1M QPS-equivalent synthetic workload and measure rerank p95 under realistic batching.
